subject: Re: Follow-up: Subprocessors & telemetry vendors (data handling details)
messages:
From: Alex Torres <a.torres@finlytics.com>

Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 25 Jun 2026 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Intro call follow-up / telemetry questions

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo today — it was helpful to see the latency guarantees and the routing controls. A few items came up on our side we want to confirm as we scope an initial pilot: 

1) Telemetry vendors: we need to understand which telemetry/observability partners Redwood shares traces/metrics with by default (Datadog, Sentry, NewRelic were mentioned verbally). Are these mandatory or opt-in?

2) Data residency: for PHI-adjacent telemetry, we need assurance that logs can be configured to remain in our US region and that any vendor access follows contractually limited scopes.

3) PII & retention: what defaults exist for request/response retention and how do we request shorter retention or masked logging for sensitive fields?

Can you send the subprocessor matrix and a short summary of the controls? Also, please confirm the next steps for a security questionnaire.

Best,
Alex
Senior Product Manager
FinLytics

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Torres <a.torres@finlytics.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 25 Jun 2026 18:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Intro call follow-up / telemetry questions

Alex —

Great to connect earlier. Quick recap and answers inline below, plus next steps. I attached a one-page subprocessor summary and our current retention defaults.

1) Telemetry vendors: Redwood uses a mix of first-party telemetry and optional integrations. Out of the box we stream service metrics and aggregated traces to our hosted observability stack. Integrations (Datadog, Sentry, NewRelic) are opt-in at the customer level — we do not share raw request/response payloads with them by default. You can opt into metric/trace forwarding, and we can limit forwarded data to non-PII signal only.

2) Data residency: For Dedicated/Private customers we support region-restricted telemetry. For Hosted customers we can route telemetry to a US-only telemetry endpoint; for PHI-sensitive workloads we recommend Redwood Private or Dedicated with VPC egress controls. Access by third-party vendors is governed by the subprocessor contract and scoped to monitoring and performance diagnostics only.

3) PII & retention: Default request/response retention for Hosted is 30 days for full payloads and 365 days for aggregated logs/metrics. We offer masked-logging (automatic redaction rules) and can configure per-customer retention windows as part of onboarding — shorter retention (7/14 days) is common. Requests for masked logging on specific JSON fields can be handled via a config file or ingestion hooks.

Next steps:
- I attached the subprocessor summary (redwood-subprocessors-summary.pdf) and our retention worksheet.
- Rishi can run through the security questionnaire and provide SOC2 artifacts if you want.
- If you’d like, we can schedule a 30-minute technical review with Vivek (ops) to walk through telemetry configuration and masking examples.

Please let me know which option you prefer for telemetry (opt-in vendor integrations vs. only first-party metrics) and your desired retention window.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-subprocessors-summary.pdf (summary of subprocessors), atlas-data-retention-reqs.docx (you attached)

Subject: Re: Intro call follow-up / telemetry questions

Thanks Marissa — that helps. A couple clarifying points from our security/compliance side: 

- We prefer vendor integrations to be opt-in and to only receive aggregated metrics (no traces with request IDs). Is that straightforward to configure?
- For the pilot we'd like masked logging with automatic redaction of the patient_id and ssn fields, and a 14-day payload retention. Can Redwood support field-level masking on Hosted or do we need Dedicated/Private to get that level of control?

Also, one of our procurement folks asked about marketplace flows — specifically if we buy through the cloud marketplace (GCP Marketplace) will Redwood still be able to configure telemetry routing and subprocessors as discussed?

If you can confirm those three things we'll share the security questionnaire and try to loop in procurement.

Best,
Alex

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Torres <a.torres@finlytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 27 Jun 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro call follow-up / telemetry questions

Alex — quick heads up from our security side: 

- Opt-in vendor integrations: yes — we forward only aggregated metrics by default when integrations are enabled. Tracing with request-level payloads is never forwarded to third-party telemetry vendors unless explicitly configured for debugging; that requires separate sign-off.

- Field-level masking: Hosted supports rule-based masking at ingestion for common patterns (PII, SSN, email) and custom JSON-path based redaction for additional fields. For extremely strict PHI controls (dedicated KMS / no egress), Dedicated or Private is recommended, but we can implement the specific field masks on Hosted for a pilot and document that in the security questionnaire.

- Marketplace purchases: buying via GCP/AWS marketplaces does not change our ability to configure telemetry routing for Hosted — we will need a marketplace contract line-item to surface the config interface, but the technical routing is the same. For Dedicated/Private via marketplace, there are additional procurement steps but the end-state config is equivalent.

I attached the SOC2 summary and a short note on subprocessor access controls (redwood-subprocessors-summary.pdf).

Next: if you send the security questionnaire, I’ll have Vivek fill the operations-specific items and we’ll aim to return it within 3 business days. Also proposing a 30-min call Monday to demo masking rules — does 10:30am PT work?

Thanks,
Rishi
Sales Engineering
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf
